response.description:
The Azure Blob Storage SDK for Rust is now generally
available. The Rust SDK allows you to connect to an Azure Blob Storage account
and perform operations on containers and blobs, including uploading,
downloading, listing, and managing blobs. This release brings production-grade
capabilities for secure, reliable access to Blob Storage from Rust, such as
Microsoft Entra ID authentication, automatic retries on transient failures, and
distributed tracing through OpenTelemetry. You now have stable APIs backed by
semver guarantees, a pluggable async runtime, and the same familiar design
patterns used across the Azure SDKs for .NET, Java, Python, JavaScript, Go, and
C++. Learn
more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Blob Storage SDK for Rust
